flagged.title: Earth-Moon-Sun: Scale, Eclipses and Tides
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly states that total solar eclipses occur 'a few per decade for any specific location on Earth' instead of roughly once every 400 years, which would lose marks on questions concerning eclipse frequency and rarity.

mark_affecting.quote: total solar eclipses are super rare, restricted to just a few per decade for any specific location on Earth.
